evidence.name: Screen field: Configure purchase button text
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Configure purchase button text" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Configure purchase button text
sections.description: Sets the visible label on the purchase subscribe button (default: Subscribe Now). The text supports template variables like pricing, duration, and custom countdown labels for dynamic personalization.
